evals.name: micro-code-pagination
evals.prompt:
You're a reviewer I'm spawning as team lead.

Mode: micro
Department: code
Target: the change in evals/files/pagination/change.diff. evals/files/pagination/before/ is the code before the change and evals/files/pagination/after/ is the code with the change applied.
Model slug: claude-opus-5-5

There's no PR, so return your findings and completion report to me.
evals.expected_output: One High finding on get_page in paginate.py: start = page * per_page skips the first page because pages are numbered from 1. No finding against page_count, whose ceiling division is correct. No architecture or design findings. Verdict: changes requested.
assertions: Reports that get_page computes start = page * per_page although pages are numbered from 1, so page 1 skips the first per_page items
Rates the get_page finding High or Critical
Does not report page_count's (total + per_page - 1) // per_page as a bug
Reports no architecture, module-structure or overall-design findings
Every finding starts with the header [CODE] | By Reviewer Micro (claude-opus-5-5)
Every finding has Issue, Suggested direction, Severity and Complexity
The completion report gives the verdict changes requested, a confidence, and the reviewed target or version
